candidates.name: cjk_bigram_confusion_memory
candidates.hypothesis: The base system's ASCII-only tokenizer returns near-zero Jaccard similarity for all Chinese document pairs, making retrieval random; replacing it with CJK character bigrams produces discriminative similarity scores and improves few-shot selection, while adding an explicit canonical-label anchor in the prompt reduces format-mismatch errors (~40% of score failures).

candidates.name: reflexion_lesson_memory
candidates.hypothesis: LLM-generated error lessons ('when facts show X the correct charge is Y, not Z') stored at learn time and injected into the prediction prompt outperform raw example storage, because the model receives pre-digested legal distinctions rather than having to infer the distinguishing rule from surface-similar examples at predict time.
